description: A bearded man in a dark fur hat and dark coat rides a black horse, one arm stretched forward in command. Behind him a crowd of men in peasant coats and fur hats carry scythes, pikes and muskets. In the background a wooden log fort with watchtowers sits on a hill, with smoke and fire rising, under a heavy grey stormy sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge. No visible wounds or blood.
